case037_root_cause.birbhan_material_note: the Birbhan/1658 sentence (SVK-1005:u03516) is present in EVERY configuration's top-5 (item 2); the P250/P500/P1000 context (missing SVK-1005:u02684) let the DAPT arm latch onto it and answer BARE '1658 by Birbhan' at the 192-token cap; the PFULL context (with u02684) elicited the hedged, abstention-correct answer

latency.methodology: Task-81 verified measurements: real BGE-M3 encoder + BM25 search_ranks(pool) + dense + RRF k=20 + top-k over the frozen 47 queries x 3 iterations (n=141 per pool); Azure VM, python 3.12.3, torch 2.14.1+cpu, 2 threads; heap top-k selection (exactly equivalent to full sort)

recommendation.reason: P500/P1000 fail the registered case037 restoration gates (BM25 rank 1110 > 1000); PFULL is the only candidate passing all registered gates and its measured p95/p99 (831/1124 ms, n=141) meet the <=2000/<=3000 ms targets
recommendation.separation_note: the BM25 pool cap is an experiment-local retrieval knob (search_ranks) not wired into production; production remains mode=bm25 unchanged; a generation-facing full-list path and a retrieval-only pool=250 path can coexist as independent configurations if adoption is later approved by an explicit task

intermediate_pool_option.note: any pool >= 1110 includes SVK-1005:u02684's bm25 rank for this query; a pool like 1500/2000/5000 was OUTSIDE the registered candidate set and was not evaluated; selecting one would require a new pre-registered mini-gate plus a 47-case confirmation run

limitations: targeted mini-gate: only differing cases freshly generated for P500/P1000; full-47 numbers for those pools are PROJECTED (fresh differing-case rows + recorded Task-75 rows elsewhere) — a projection, not a fresh full run
